## Why it happens

You tried to create something beyond a licence limit, for example one device more than the licence allows. Nothing was created. Devices that a gateway or provisioning would add are refused the same way.

## Fix it

- Delete what you no longer need, or
- ask your supplier for a licence with higher limits and activate it.

The **License** page lists every limit next to its current use.

## Check that it worked

Creating the item works, and the **License** page shows use below the limit.
